# General information

We may  *attempt* to live stream, the live in-person sessions.  Please note that it is UCL's expectation that students attend in-person.  The Zoom link is available [here](https://ucl.zoom.us/my/terrysoo).  Not all sessions will be recorded or streamed.  The recording [link](https://moodle.ucl.ac.uk/mod/url/view.php?id=9436609) is password protected, with the password available on Moodle.
